prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: full-width 16:9 cinematic environment for an existing Godot pixel-art Greek Odyssey game.
Reference image 1 is the established ship-deck environment: preserve the wooden ancient Greek ship, mast, ropes, bronze fittings, round shields and cream square sail with red Greek meander border. Reference image 2 shows the game's detailed pixel-art style and palette, only use it as style guidance, do not place large characters in the new image.
Primary request: create the same ship suddenly caught in a terrifying violent storm at sea, shortly after the Cyclops act. Viewed from the stern looking forward across the wet rocking deck towards a distant rocky island. Giant dark teal breaking waves tower above the railings, wind stretches the sail and ropes, white foam and rain sweep across the ship, heavy blue-black storm clouds with one brilliant branching lightning bolt near the distant island illuminate the deck. A few other ancient Greek ships struggle in the sea to the side at middle distance, part of Odysseus's fleet. The distant island should be legible on the center-left horizon, small but clearly the destination.
Style: richly detailed, crisp pixel-art cinematic illustration, dithered color clusters, visible controlled pixel edges, no blurry painterly brushwork. Match reference 1's architecture and reference 2's expressive dense pixel rendering.
Composition: immersive wide 16:9 landscape, mast slightly right of center, waves and fleet visible either side, open deck foreground with no large faces or figures, usable negative space behind separately animated character portraits. Main dramatic lightning, sail and wave crests in upper two-thirds. Bottom quarter darker wet deck for subtitles composited in game. Full bleed opaque background.
Mood: abrupt danger and desperation, home almost within reach but survival uncertain. Cold slate blue, sea green, white lightning highlights, dark weathered brown wood, small deep red sail trim. Historically ancient Greece, steering oar rather than modern ship wheel.
Constraints: no text, no UI, no logos, no watermark, no modern technology, no cyclops, no Athena, no large foreground characters, no border.
